parsed.note_claim: La publicación traduce un post original de una familia en Singapur sobre un incidente en su coffeeshop.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: CCTV footages were posted on Bei-Ing Wanton Noodle's Facebook and Instagram profiles on the same day. They wrote in the first post: "Today, an incident happened at our coffeeshop that has left our entire family extremely upset and concerned."
parsed.reason: The article confirms the original content came from a Singapore family's social media profiles with matching text.
